newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine central gov't March deficit $550.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentine central gov't March deficit $550.2 mln.

text.p: Argentina registered a central government deficit in March of $550.2 million compared with a $650 million deficit for the same month a year earlier, the Economy Ministry announced Thursday.
The Treasury's total income for the month was $1.41 billion versus expenditure of $1.96 billion. Current income was $1.4 billion versus current spending of $1.89 billion.
The ministry revised its deficit for March 1996 to $527 million.
Capital income was $7.1 million versus capital spending of $62.2 million.
The deficit figure was anticipated by Treasury Secretary Pablo Guidotti a day earlier, when he said it meant Argentina had met targets agreed for March with the International Monetary Fund.
An IMF mission is now in Argentina monitoring central government accounts prior to negotiations to set up an extended fund facility from 1998 to 2000.
